reason: The plugin is a UI extension for the DeepSeek Harness web client that focuses on in-conversation navigation, exposing markers for user messages and allowing jump and preview interactions, so it should be classified as a navigation/panels plugin rather than a general utility or automation tool.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的会话导航插件，在对话旁侧显示可交互书签，支持悬停预览并可通过点击或方向键快速跳转到对应消息。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web UI extension that adds a side conversation navigator with message markers, hover previews, and click or keyboard controls to jump directly to specific turns.

capabilities: Adds UI markers into the DeepSeek Harness web conversation view
Reads conversation data from the active DSH session snapshot
Links markers to rendered chat DOM nodes for jump actions
Scrolls the conversation view to selected turns
Loads older history through DSH session API when needed

reasons.code: README describes a compact rail beside the conversation with markers, hover previews, and click/keyboard navigation to message turns.
README states the plugin uses DSH sessions service and stable data attributes to map each marker to rendered messages.
package.json declares a web platform DSH client plugin with injected @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime.
